title: Private Louisiana Plantations Tour with Gourmet Lunch from New Orleans

Hotel pickup and drop-off, with exact pick up time provided

blurb: Experience a pilgrimage back in time to the Antebellum South on this private van tour. Visit two Louisiana plantations, including an elegant, unlimited buffet lunch at Houmas House on the famous Mississippi River Road! Enjoy a narrated scenic drive out of New Orleans and along the shores of Lake Ponchartrain.
